answer.reason: Several events of the story belong to Bethlehem itself: Rachel's burial on the way to it, the birth of Jesus there, and the slaughter of its children.

clauses.english: had Rachel buried on the way to it
clauses.quote: Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

clauses.english: was where Jesus was born in the days of Herod the king
clauses.quote: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king

clauses.english: had its young children slain by Herod
clauses.quote: slew all the children that were in Bethlehem

doubts: Verses naming the Bethlehemite Jesse, Elhanan, Asahel's tomb, or the Levite and concubine mention the town only as a home or origin, so were left out.
Rachel's burial is said to be on the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem, so the clause says on the way to it.
Genealogy, census, Rehoboam's fortifying and the prophecy verses were not used as events.
